summary.text: Julie Rogers is a Democratic state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 41 and the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physical therapist, she is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Julie Rogers earned a master's degree in physical therapy from Marquette University and has worked as a physical therapist.
She has served on the National Association of Counties Health Steering Committee, the West Michigan Cancer Center Board and the Bronson Hospital Patient & Family Advisory Council.
In the House, Rogers chaired the Health Policy Committee in 2023 and 2024 and also served on the Financial Services Committee.
In 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the House Appropriations Committee.
